name: Red and Beauty (or The 120 Days)
source:
Three wealthy libertines devote a summer to enjoying sensual and sexual pleasures. They move into a remote baroque palace, Faunenburg, and bring with them a group of beautiful boys.

Story-tellers entertain and inspire them with tales of passion: simple, complex, criminal, and murderous...*

[*This is all structurally based on the Marquis de Sade's The 120 Days of Sodom.]

[From [url=https://milkycherry.itch.io/red-and-beauty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三名富有的放荡者将整个夏天投入感官与肉体享乐。他们搬进偏远的巴洛克宫殿福嫩堡，并带来一群美貌少年。

说书人为他们讲述激情故事，令他们感到兴奋：有简单的、复杂的、犯罪的，也有谋杀的……*

[*本作的结构完全基于萨德侯爵的《索多玛的120天》。]
